segments.thag8.2:1.3: Sa ve tādisako bhikkhu, evaṃ pecca na socati.
segments.thag8.2:2.3: Guttadvāro sadā bhikkhu, evaṃ pecca na socati.
segments.thag8.2:3.3: Kalyāṇasīlo so [yo (syā.)] bhikkhu, evaṃ pecca na socati.
segments.thag8.2:4.3: Kalyāṇamitto so bhikkhu, evaṃ pecca na socati.
segments.thag8.2:5.3: Kalyāṇapañño so bhikkhu, evaṃ pecca na socati.

lines: Tasmāti, yasmā yathāvuttasaddhādiguṇasamannāgato puggalo “adaliddo amoghajīvito”ti vuccati, tasmā ahampi tathārūpo bhaveyyanti.

Saddhañca … pe … sāsananti “sabbapāpassa akaraṇan”tiādinā (dha. pa.183; dī. ni.2.90) vuttaṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ anussaranto kulaputto vuttappabhedaṃ saddhañceva sīlañca dhammadassanahetukaṃ dhamme sunicchayā vimokkhabhūtaṃ pasādañca anuyuñjeyya vaḍḍheyyāti.
